candidates.name: Acute Transverse Myelitis
support_spans: marked paraparesis of the lower limbs
hyperreflexia with sustained clonus in the lower extremities
diffuse T2 hyperintensities throughout the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar cord
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of paraparesis, hyperreflexia, and clonus, along with the spinal MRI findings, are consistent with acute transverse myelitis.

candidates.name: Multiple Sclerosis
support_spans: multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions in the periventricular and periaqueductal regions
diffusion restriction and low ADC values
candidates.why: The patient's brain MRI findings, including multiple bilateral lesions and diffusion restriction, are consistent with multiple sclerosis.

candidates.name: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder
support_spans: acute urinary retention
progressive neurological deficits
diffuse T2 hyperintensities throughout the cervical, thoracic, and lumbar cord
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and MRI findings are consistent with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, an autoimmune disease that affects the central nervous system.

candidates.name: Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis
support_spans: multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions
febrile, and his condition deteriorated into respiratory distress
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and MRI findings are consistent with acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, an inflammatory disease that affects the central nervous system.

candidates.name: Lymphoma
support_spans: lymphadenopathy in the bilateral cervical and axillary regions
marked peri- and pararenal soft-tissue infiltration
candidates.why: The patient's contrast-enhanced CT findings, including lymphadenopathy and soft-tissue infiltration, are consistent with lymphoma.

candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: multiple bilateral, symmetrical T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions
lymphadenopathy in the bilateral cervical and axillary regions
candidates.why: The patient's MRI and CT findings are consistent with sarcoidosis, a disease that can affect multiple organs, including the central nervous system.
